newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Esprit ESPR in Indonesia road venture.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Esprit ESPR in Indonesia road venture.

text.p: Malaysia's Esprit Group Bhd said it has signed a joint venture agreement with Indonesian companies to build the proposed Semarang-Demak Toll Road in Java for a period of 30 years.
The proposed road is a 24.17 km, dual four-lane carriageway connecting Semarang and Demak in Central Java, Perwira Affin Merchant Bank Bhd said on Sunday in a statement on behalf of Esprit.
The total investment cost of the project is estimated at 572 million ringgit, the statement said.
Perwira Affin said based on the intended debt-to-equity ratio of 75 to 25 the internal rate of return on equity was projected at 25.09 percent.
The payback period would be 11 years, calculated from the beginning of construction, which is scheduled to begin in mid-1997 and completed in three years.
Esprit, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Esprit Overseas Sdn Bhd, would hold 35 percent of the equity, Indonesia's PT Mawatindo Road Construction 55 percent and PT Jasa Marga 10 percent.
The joint venture company would be known as PT Marga Mawatindo Esprit, the statement said.
